Add entries here in the same PR as each release-notes.html bullet. A release in release-notes.html at or after 'start' with no entries here is posted straight from its bullets with the NEW stamp drawing. 'skip': true leaves an item out. No em-dashes. art = social/whats-new/art/NAME.svg. link = page on nevadacitynugget.com.

items.head: Extra! Extra! Read All About Us!
items.deck: When Total Circulation passes a milestone, an Extra! box with its own drawing pops up under the date. And if you happen to be the exact milestone copy, the paper tells you so.
items.body: Every time Total Circulation passes a milestone (500, 1,000, 1,500 and on up), an Extra! box with its own drawing appears under the date that day and the next, and we celebrate here too. If your copy is the exact milestone copy, the paper tells you, and the bragging rights are yours. The count is the same honest one as always: copies of today's paper read at nevadacitynugget.com, one per phone or computer a day, no names kept.
items.alt: A cartoon newsboy hollering and waving a paper that reads EXTRA!

items.head: Seven Mornings Running, and Still a Greenhorn!
items.deck: Prospector's Streak counts the mornings in a row you read the paper. Seven days makes you a Greenhorn, thirty a Sourdough, a hundred an Old-Timer.
items.body: Under the date you'll now find your Prospector's Streak: "Day 6 at the claim" means six mornings in a row with the Nugget. Hit 7 days and you're a Greenhorn, 30 a Sourdough, 100 an Old-Timer. The tally lives only in your own browser; we never see it.
items.alt: A bearded cartoon prospector pointing proudly at a tally board marked Day 7

items.head: Eureka! Now Keep It Under Your Hat.
items.deck: The Hidden Nugget: a tiny gold nugget is tucked somewhere different in every edition. Find it, tap it, and add it to your poke.
items.body: The Hidden Nugget: every morning a tiny gold nugget is tucked somewhere new in the paper. Find it and tap it. We won't say where today's is. Your finds stay in your own browser, same as your streak.
items.alt: A cartoon fellow in a derby squinting through a magnifying glass at a tiny gold nugget

items.head: Heave Ho, Partner! The Next Milestone's Over the Hill
items.deck: A little progress bar under the date now shows how many copies to go before the next Extra! Every reader, and every friend you wire the paper to, moves the needle.
items.body: A little progress bar now sits under the date, showing how many copies to go before the next circulation milestone. Every morning you read moves it, and so does every friend you wire the paper to (tap "Wire The Nugget" in any edition).
items.alt: A cartoon fellow pushing a cart of newspapers up a hill toward a red flag

items.head: Hold Your Horses! The Picture Show Comes in February
items.deck: SYRCL's Wild & Scenic Film Festival turns 25, Feb. 18 to 22, 2027. The Nugget now watches it every morning: new films, schedules and deadlines as they post.
items.body: SYRCL's Wild & Scenic Film Festival turns 25 this winter, Feb. 18 to 22, 2027, and the Nugget now keeps watch on it every morning: new films, schedules and deadlines as they post, a countdown in Amusements the two weeks before, and a Plan Ahead box in the Visitor Guide.
items.alt: A cartoon hand-crank movie camera filming a salmon leaping from the river

items.head: Neat as a Pin! Somebody Finally Swept Up Out Front
items.deck: The pile of notices above the news is gone. The classic nameplate stays, the day's lead story runs big on the first screen, and a slim nameplate bar follows you down the page.
items.body: The front page got a makeover. The classic nameplate stays, the Beta badge shrinks to a small stamp, and the day's lead headline now runs big and bold on the first screen. Email sign-up, Total Circulation and the Inside strip moved to just under the lead story, and a slim nameplate bar follows you down the page with a quick way back to the top.
items.alt: A cartoon fellow in a bow tie sweeping a pile of notices off the front page

items.head: Many Hands Make Light Work, and This Town's Got Plenty
items.deck: Good Works: a standing guide to 33 local nonprofits, what each does, where to find it, and how to give, join or pitch in. Nonprofit of the Day starts on Giving Tuesday, Dec. 1.
items.body: New: Good Works, a standing guide to 33 Nevada City nonprofits, from the Miners Foundry and the Narrow Gauge Railroad Museum to SYRCL, Child Advocates and the Odd Fellows: what each does, where to find it, and how to give, join or pitch in. And starting Giving Tuesday, Dec. 1, a Nonprofit of the Day runs each morning through the giving season. No one pays to appear.
items.alt: Three cartoon gloved hands passing an upturned top hat as coins and hearts fly in

items.head: Pictures, by Golly! Ain't We Gone Fancy.
items.deck: Every section of the Visitor Guide now opens under its own drawing: a covered dish for the Bill of Fare, batwing doors for the Bar Guide, ridgelines for Trails & Vistas, and more.
items.body: The Nevada City Visitor Guide got some fresh ink. Every section now opens under a slim illustrated band, drawn for the Nugget: a covered dish for the Bill of Fare, batwing doors for the Bar Guide, ridgelines for Trails & Vistas, and more. They switch to light ink in dark mode.
items.alt: A cartoon painter in a red beret at an easel, painting a pair of saloon batwing doors

items._why: schedule tweak (Red Dot notice Wed-Sun), not news for new readers

items.head: Step Right Up! Tonics & Tinctures for the Weary Traveler
items.deck: Seventeen Nevada City apothecaries, elixir bars, limbering parlors, healers and rock shops in one new guide. The Daily Restorative spotlights one each morning from Nov. 19.
items.body: Gather 'round, friends. New at the Nugget: Tonics & Tinctures, the Nevada City Wellness Guide. Seventeen of the town's apothecaries, elixir bars, yoga and Pilates parlors, spas, healers, rock shops and the pottery studio, each in its own words, with a wink from the medicine wagon. Starting Thursday, Nov. 19, The Daily Restorative spotlights one each morning. The Nugget cures nothing, not even Mondays. No one pays to appear.
items.alt: A cartoon old-time medicine bottle labeled Tonics and Tinctures, with gold sparkles

items.head: A Shorter Paper, Every Word Still There
items.deck: The Nugget went on a diet: about a third shorter on your phone. Long lists now start folded, and a tap unfolds them.
items.body: The Nugget had grown to about 49 phone screens, and only a dozen of them were news. It now runs about 34. Nothing was thrown out. The Holiday Table moved to the Visitor Guide, four City Hall boxes became one, and the long lists (regional agendas, the calendar further out, the full Radio Log, standing legal notices) now start folded. Tap one and it unfolds, every word still there.

items.head: Tune In, Nevada City!
items.deck: On the third Wednesday of every month, a Tonight box at the top of the paper points you to Under the Influence on 89.5 KVMR FM, 8 to 10 PM.
items.body: Jerianne Van Dijk and Todd Wahoske host Under the Influence, a musical journey through time, space and cultures, on 89.5 KVMR FM the third Wednesday of every month from 8 to 10 PM. On those nights the Nugget now carries a Tonight box at the top of the paper from 7 to 11 PM, with links to listen live, the playlists and the KVMR Archives.
items.alt: An old radio microphone sending out sound waves

items.head: Missed the Show? Listen Again!
items.deck: The Radio Log now has a Listen Again button for Under the Influence: Crooner Lounge, Vol. 2, streaming through Dec. 2.
items.body: Jerianne Van Dijk and Todd Wahoske's Nov. 18 Under the Influence, Crooner Lounge Vol. 2, aired 8 to 10 PM on 89.5 KVMR FM. The Nugget's Radio Log now carries a Listen Again button that streams it from the KVMR archive, skipping the dead air at the top, through Dec. 2.
items.alt: An old radio microphone sending out sound waves

items.note: Housekeeping (disclaimers consolidated); left out of social posts.

items.head: KVMRx Joins the Radio Log
items.deck: KVMR's sister station, KVMRx at 105.7 FM, now has its own line in the Radio Log, with the whole week a tap away.
items.body: The Radio Log now carries KVMRx, KVMR's sister station at 105.7 FM. The day's shows from 6 AM to midnight sit on one line under KVMR's, and "Unfold the KVMRx week" opens all seven days, reruns included, starting with today. The lineup comes from the station's own Spinitron calendar.

items.head: Meetings, On Their Own
items.deck: New City Council and Planning Commission meetings now land on Meetings on the Record by themselves, transcript and summary.
items.body: When the city posts a new City Council or Planning Commission video, the Nugget now writes up its transcript and a plain-English "Short of It" summary without anyone sending a link. First up: the November 19 Planning Commission, including a test dome for Geoship.

items.head: Park First. Then the Necessary.
items.deck: The Visitor Guide now opens with two big buttons: where to park downtown, and where the public restrooms are.
items.body: Drove an hour to get here? The Nevada City Visitor Guide now starts with what you need first. Where to Park lists the city's public lots, the meter rates and the streets the city suggests for all-day stays. The Necessary, the 1800s word for a privy, lists the public restrooms downtown.

items.head: The Visitor Guide, Dressed Up
items.deck: A new drawing of Broad Street, picture buttons, a nightlife guide, an arts guide, and a downtown directory of more than 90 places.
items.body: The Nevada City Visitor Guide got a new suit of clothes: a drawing of Broad Street up top, picture buttons for each part of the guide, After Dark for nightlife, Galleries & Stages for the arts, and Spotlight on Downtown Nevada City, a directory of more than 90 shops, tables, bars, stages and inns.

items.head: Holiday posts
Shortcuts to Supper
items.deck: New buttons on the Visitor Guide jump straight to downtown restaurants, coffee, Seven Hills kitchens and the markets.
items.body: The Nevada City Visitor Guide has new shortcuts. Under The Bill of Fare, a row of buttons jumps straight to the downtown restaurants, coffee and sweets, the Seven Hills kitchens and the markets. The Bar Guide, the nightlife guide and the arts guide have the same.

items.head: Curtain Up on Commercial Street
items.deck: Off Broadstreet, the cabaret dessert theatre at 305 Commercial, is now in the Visitor Guide and the paper's Amusements.
items.body: Off Broadstreet, the cabaret dessert theatre at 305 Commercial Street, is now in the Nevada City Visitor Guide's downtown directory, arts guide and nightlife guide. When a show is coming up, the paper lists it under Amusements, starting with Holiday Express, November 28 through December 20.
